Bob is a giant snail. He's behind you on the path, and he never stops moving. Your real daily steps are the only thing keeping him off your back.

- If he catches you, you die. A tombstone is placed at your distance, permanently visible to every other player who walks past.

Every player walks the same path. Pass other pilgrims, walk by their graves, pay respects at a tombstone with a candle, a stone, or a flower. Compete on the Hall of Fame leaderboard for furthest distance ever survived.

SET YOUR OWN PACE
Bob's speed is adjustable - start easier, or make it brutal. It's the only setting that's yours to change, and it's never for sale.

results.description:
■ Japanese Walking, simplified — walk out, turn around, walk home

Step outside on your lunch break. Walk in any direction. The timer flips you between 3 minutes brisk and 3 minutes slow, and at the halfway mark, a clear cue tells you when to turn around. Walk back the way you came and end right where you started — no route planning, no map staring, no detours.

A real workout, fitted into a coffee break.


■ What is Japanese Walking?

The walking method trending online as "Japanese walking" is Interval Walking Training (IWT) — 3 minutes brisk, 3 minutes slow, repeated 5 times. Developed through research at Shinshu University in Japan, it's reported to offer comparable health benefits to walking 10,000 steps a day, in less time.


■ The FLIP cue — your turnaround signal

FLIP marks the halfway point with a voice cue, sound, and vibration. The walking screen color also flips to signal the return leg.

You don't have to plan a route or calculate distance. Just walk straight out, wait for the FLIP, and walk back. Every session loops cleanly back to where you started.

FLIP can be turned off for fixed loops, treadmills, or one-way walks like a commute.


■ Apple Watch & AirPods — go screen-free

Start a session on iPhone and it syncs to your Apple Watch, with each phase change delivered as a haptic tap. Or leave iPhone at home and run a full session on Apple Watch alone.

Pair AirPods for voice cues in your ears, alongside your music or videos. With Apple Watch or AirPods, your iPhone stays in your pocket.


■ Lock Screen & Dynamic Island, too

While you walk, you can glance at your current phase and progress on the Lock Screen Live Activity or in Dynamic Island.


■ Two taps to start

1. Pick the number of sets
2. Tap Start

That's it. Custom sound and voice cues mark every phase change and the finish. Hold iPhone for a vibration at each switch, or keep it in your pocket and get cues by Apple Watch haptics and AirPods voice.


■ Flexible sessions

- Start from 1 set (6 min), pick any number you like
- Up to 20 sets per session


■ The 20-set weekly target

Research recommends 20 brisk-walking sets per week — that's "5 sets × 4 days." Split them across the week, do just 1 on a busy day, or knock them all out on a Saturday. The weekly total is what counts.


■ Pace, in plain language

"Brisk" means a pace where you can just barely hold a conversation but you can't sing. Walk a little faster than your usual stroll and you're in the zone, regardless of age or fitness level.


■ History and Apple Health

- Every session is saved with its GPS route
- Workouts auto-sync to Apple Health
- Weekly and monthly progress at a glance


■ Journey — your distance, mapped onto a legendary road

Your cumulative walking distance is laid onto Japan's historic Tokaido (53 Stations), with your current position shown on a map. Walk the 492 km from Nihonbashi (modern Tokyo) to Kyoto, set by set, passing Shinagawa, Hakone, Hamamatsu. Each checkpoint also supports Apple Maps Look Around, so you can peek at the place today. Reach Kyoto and you've walked the entire Tokaido.


■ Privacy first

- Your location, routes, and health data stay on your device — never sent externally
- No personally identifiable information collected (only anonymous usage stats to improve the app)
- No account required

results.description:
Three minutes easy, three minutes brisk, repeat — the Japanese walking method, coached start to finish. A real coach's voice tells you when to switch. It never cuts off your podcast. And you don't need an Apple Watch.

Most training plans fail the same way: you quit them. This one is built to be kept. In the original Shinshu University research, interval walkers gained real fitness, stronger legs, and lower blood pressure in five months — and nearly everyone stuck with the program, because every brisk push is followed by three easy minutes. It never stops feeling like a walk.

Aruki is that method, made calm.

The method is simple: walk briskly for three minutes, then ease off for three, and repeat five times. Researchers call it interval walking training. You'll just call it the best part of your day.

Aruki guides every interval so you never watch the clock. A soft chime and a warm, natural voice — recorded in your own language, free for everyone — tell you when to ease off and when to push. Eyes up, phone in your pocket. Your music or podcast keeps playing the whole time; the cue just ducks under it for a second. When you're done, your walk becomes a quiet card worth keeping.

• Keeps your music and podcasts playing — the cue ducks, then your audio returns

results.description:
Hitting your step goal shouldn't feel like staring at a number that won't move.

Foray turns your daily step goal into a real destination. Tell it how many steps you want, how far you want to walk, or how much time you have, and Foray finds a place nearby that's exactly the right distance away. A park. A coffee shop you've never tried. A bookstore across the neighborhood. Walk there and back, and your goal takes care of itself.

WHY FORAY IS DIFFERENT

Most fitness apps just count. Foray gives your steps a reason. Instead of an abstract number, you get a real place to go.

• Set your goal your way: steps, distance, or the time you have
• Get a real destination matched to what you like (parks, cafes, landmarks, trails, and more)
• Already partway there? Walks are sized to what's left of today's goal
• See the place before you go, with a photo or a look around the street out front where Apple Maps has it
• Don't want to choose? One Pick hands you one place a day, with one pass
• See every match on a map, numbered in the order Foray recommends
• Walk there with your phone's own Maps app, no new navigation to learn
• Follow your walk from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
• Mark when you arrive and see your there-and-back split
• See every place you've walked to on your Atlas, a private map
• Every foray saves to Apple Health as a walking workout
• Keep two streaks, your forays and your daily goal, with repairs for a missed foray day
• Earn badges as you hit milestones, reach new places, and grow your streaks
• Follow friends and see where they've been in your feed
• Cheer on their walks and nudge a friend who's gone quiet
• Design share cards for a walk, your day, your week, your Atlas or your profile
• Walk together in real time with Co-Walk
• Light or dark, Foray follows your phone or lets you choose

YOUR PRIVACY, RESPECTED

Foray uses your location to find your destination, then lets it go. It never records the route you walk. Your live position leaves your phone only when you choose to share a walk, and then only with the people you send that link to, only until you finish. Only the places you choose to visit are saved to your private history. No ads. No data selling. Not now, not ever.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE

Fewer options nearby? Foray tells you honestly when a destination sits a little past your goal instead of leaving you stuck. Only have a 30-minute lunch break? Set a time goal instead of a step count.

BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Follow the people you walk with and see their forays in a shared feed. Cheer each other on, nudge a friend who's gone quiet, or start a Co-Walk and head out together in real time.

FORAY PREMIUM

Free to download and use. Premium adds Live Link, so someone you trust can follow your walk in their browser while you take it, with no app and no account on their end. It also adds notes and photos on your walks, advanced Insights and records, Co-Walk groups up to 8, every destination category, unlimited new places, automatic streak repair, and more share card looks.

Stop staring at a number. Start walking somewhere.

results.description:
My Steps Walking supports a structured walking program for people living with peripheral artery disease (PAD), from the Global PAD Association.

Walking is central to living well with PAD, and this app is built to make each session easy to record and easy to share with your care team.

RECORD EVERY WALK
Start a session and the app keeps time while you walk. Mark when discomfort begins, rest when you need to, then continue — the app tracks each part of the cycle so you can see the full picture of your session.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
After each walk, review your steps, session time, time spent walking, time at rest, and how long you walked through discomfort. Over weeks, your history builds into a record you and your clinician can look at together.

THE 6-MINUTE WALKING TEST
Take the standard 6-minute walk on your own schedule, whenever you and your care team want a checkpoint. Stop any time — your walk still counts.

NOTE HOW YOU FELT
Tap to record symptoms after a session — calf cramping, thigh pain, foot numbness, heaviness, and more — or add a note in your own words.

TRACK YOUR NUMBERS
Keep blood pressure, weight, and blood glucose in the same place as your walking history.

THE GREAT CIRCULATION CHALLENGE
Every September, walkers around the world combine their steps into a single 60,000-mile journey through the circulatory system. Join a team, follow the community's progress along 39 checkpoints, and learn how circulation works as each one is reached.

CONNECT YOUR STEPS
Link the Health app and steps you take outside a session count toward the Challenge automatically. We read step counts only — no other health data — and you can disconnect at any time.

PRIVACY
Your walking history and any vitals you enter are visible to you and your own care team. We never sell your information, we show no ads, and the app does not collect your location.

ABOUT
My Steps Walking is provided by the Global PAD Association, a patient advocacy organization. This app records and displays your own activity. It is not a medical device, does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and is not a substitute for care from your clinician. Always follow the guidance of your own care team, and seek medical attention for any concerning symptoms.

results.description:
Introduced in NHK BS1 Walkers TV "The 2nd Kyoto Edition.
Featured in the February 2022 issue of “大人のおしゃれ手帖”.

World Heritage Walking (Pedometer) is a health care application that works in conjunction with the pedometer on your smartphone or Apple Watch to take you on a World Heritage adventure. 

More than 400 World Heritage sites are available, and courses are set so that users can achieve "8,000 steps per day. Users can virtually visit World Heritage sites on the map in conjunction with the pedometer at cultural, natural, and composite World Heritage sites around the world. 

Users set a goal to reach a World Heritage site, so the application encourages walking and helps users get exercise. 
It may even help you study for the World Heritage Examination!

■ There are over 400 registered World Heritage sites!
A total of more than 400 World Heritage sites in Asia, Europe, South America, Africa, Oceania, and North and Central America can be visited on the app. Users can freely select the World Heritage sites they wish to visit. All they have to do is walk with their phone! The app counts the number of steps you take and moves you to your destination.

■ A simple pedometer function is included! You can immediately check the number of steps taken and calories burned in a day!
Easily check the number of steps taken, calories burned, distance walked, and time spent in a day. Users can set a target number of steps to see if they are on track to meet their goal. Users can also check their weekly step count on a bar graph or line graph.

■ A step count calendar is also included! Check your monthly step count!
You can check the number of steps you have taken each month on the step count calendar. If the target number of steps has been reached, the gauge will be maxed out and a check mark will be added. The number of steps is visualized in an easy-to-understand manner, so you can immediately check if you have achieved your daily step count goal. You can also check the number of steps taken per hour on a bar graph or line graph.

■ Post the results of your daily steps with the SNS function! Keep your motivation up with the "likes" that people give you!
Users can post comments when they reach a World Heritage Site. The postings can be viewed and "liked" by users all over the world. Users can see the comments and "likes" and stay motivated to continue walking without getting bored.

■ Data is securely managed in the cloud!
User data can be securely managed in the cloud using your Apple or Google account. Even if you delete the app or change the model of your smartphone, you can continue to use the app in the same state as before.

■ Designed to conserve your phone's battery, so you can go out with peace of mind!
To reduce battery consumption, the number of steps is not monitored in real time. The number of steps is not monitored even when the app is in the background. The app is designed to acquire the number of steps only when the number of steps is necessary due to user operations while the app is in the foreground, thus reducing the battery consumption of the smartphone. Compared to conventional pedometers, which consume large amounts of battery power, this energy-saving design allows you to use the app with peace of mind.

results.description:
Walk every street in your city and watch your map fill up as you explore.

Streets is a walking tracker built for people who want to explore more, discover new neighborhoods, and see exactly which streets they’ve already walked and which ones are still waiting.

Every walk adds to your personal city map. Streets highlights the roads and streets you’ve covered, tracks your progress, and turns everyday walking into a simple challenge: how much of your city can you complete?

Explore Every Street

See your explored and unvisited streets directly on the map. Choose a new area, find streets you haven’t walked yet, and gradually complete more of your city.

Whether you’re exploring your neighborhood, discovering a new city, or trying to walk every street, Streets gives you a clear sense of progress every time you go outside.

Track Your Walks with GPS

Start a walk and Streets records your route using GPS. See where you went, how far you traveled, and how your route contributed to your city progress.

Use Streets to:

• Track walks, runs, and bike rides
• Record distance, duration, pace, steps, and calories
• View your route on the map
• Keep a history of your activities
• See which streets you’ve already explored
• Find streets and areas you haven’t visited yet

Step Counter and Walking Tracker

Streets includes a built-in pedometer and step counter, so you can track your steps alongside your GPS routes.

Monitor your walking distance, activity, and progress while every new route helps build a more complete map of where you’ve been.

Plan New Walking Routes

Use the route planner to create custom walking routes and explore parts of your city you haven’t covered yet.

Plan a walk through unfamiliar streets, save your route, and turn your next outing into another step toward completing your city.

Make Walking More Interesting

Streets is more than a step counter or GPS tracker.

Instead of walking the same routes again and again, you always have somewhere new to go. Unvisited streets become your next destination, your city becomes the challenge, and every walk moves your progress forward.

Walk more. Explore more. Complete your map.

Download Streets and start exploring every street in your city.

Track your run progress in real time with jS (just Start) Running. Control functions with simple gestures, monitor your stats at a glance from a big bold font and color coded display.  It all helps to minimise distraction from your running, jogging or walking activity. 
The running display screens provide a super clear summary of your progress at a glance from any angle (perfect for when using an armband). Music controls have never been easier with intuitive tap or swipe gesture control.

- Big, Bold, High Contrast & Color coded Display which is easy to read in any condition.

- Advanced Music Gesture Controls provide complete control of your playlists/playback and complete the package to give you the ultimate easy to use running/walking/jogging app.
- Direct links to Workout stations & jS Playlist on Apple Music. 
These features are perfect for live tracking of the key run stats with a simple glance, thereby allowing the runner to concentrating on the path ahead. 
- Safety features to aid in emergency situations:  
 * Alarm function to draw attention of passersby.
 * Instant call emergency or a saved contact number.
 * SMS your run details and location to a saved contact.
 * Turn your iPhone to a side light when running at dusk or dark.

Other Features:
- Innovative, glance free, “safe-mode” which kicks in when you start running/jogging, dims the screen and minimises battery drain.

results.description:
The Japanese interval walking method, coached from your wrist.

Three minutes fast, three minutes slow. It's almost impossible to pace correctly on your own. Just Walk is the coach: haptic cues on your Apple Watch keep your fast intervals actually fast, without audio, without looking at your phone.

WHAT MAKES JUST WALK DIFFERENT
• CADENCE COACHING — Live steps-per-minute with a target band for every fast interval. Fall off the pace and your wrist tells you. Hit it and you'll know.
• A SCREEN YOU READ AT A GLANCE — When you do look, the whole screen is the stretch you're in: green for fast, blue for slow, with a tide that rises as it runs and a countdown into every change. In fast stretches, a dot swings at your target pace. Your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island carry the same colour, the time left and what's next.
• SEE HOW IT WENT — After an interval walk, a chart shows each fast stretch against your pace band, with one plain sentence that sums it up.
• THE 4-WEEK PROGRAM — Start at 3 cycles, and the plan adapts to how you actually walk: finish strong and it levels up; struggle and it repeats the week. Miss a day? The program waits for you.
• WE NOTICE REAL LIFE — Walked briskly to the train for 14 minutes? That counts. Just Walk credits walking you did without opening the app.
• HOW IT'S GOING — Two honest numbers. Showing Up counts the walking you did. Ease watches whether walks are getting easier for your body — compared to one person only: you, weeks ago. Most weeks it says Steady, because that's the truth. It isn't a grade or a medical measurement, just a mirror we hold steady.
• STREAKS THAT FORGIVE — Daily step streaks with 4 shields a month (bank up to 8) for the days life happens. If a shield can cover a missed day, your streak waits on Today, dimmed, until you decide. Use one and you see it land on the day it saved. Free for everyone.

BUILT FOR IPHONE DUO
Just Walk fits both screens. Closed, it's the Just Walk you know on the outer display. Open it upright for the same layout at full size, or turn it sideways to see your step ring beside your day. Half-folded like a laptop mid-walk, the phase and time sit on the top half and your pace and controls on the bottom, clear of the crease.

ALSO IN JUST WALK
• Step tracking that matches Apple Health
• Tap your step ring to see about how many minutes of walking are left, at the pace of your recent walks (a steady walk until you have some)
• VoiceOver announces each new stretch of an interval walk, with its time and what's next
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Fat Burn Zone walks with live heart-rate guidance (Apple Watch)
• Post-meal walks: 10 minutes on your feet after you eat
• Full Apple Watch app with complications

TRY THE COACHING FREE
Every interval walk comes with live cadence coaching, including your free weekly walk. The first 7 days of the program are free too, and your How it's going numbers are free, always. Just Walk Pro unlocks the full 4-week program, unlimited coached walks, and the story behind your numbers: full history, your weekly Ease readings, and a note from your coach about why they moved. Eligible new subscribers can start with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan.

No account. No ads. Your step counts and other health data stay on your devices, in Apple Health; iCloud syncs your streaks and walks without them.

WalkReady is a walking app for people rebuilding stamina from a low baseline, after surgery, illness, injury, weight gain, or a long pause. It starts from your last walk's step count and adds only what you choose.

Most walking apps are built for people who are already fit. WalkReady is built for people rebuilding stamina, after surgery, illness, weight gain, or a long pause. No streaks. No badges. No pressure.

How it works:

Open WalkReady and you'll see your last walk's step count. That's your current stamina. Choose how many steps to add today. Maybe a hundred. Maybe none. Maybe a few hundred if you're feeling good.

Then start walking. Your phone tracks your steps in the background. At the halfway point, WalkReady plays a quiet audio cue and a small buzz. That's your turn-around signal. Walk back the way you came.

Tap done when you're home. Your walk is saved. Tomorrow, you decide again.

That's the whole app. Out and back. Honest progress.

It works whether you're at 10,000 steps a day or 10:

WalkReady meets you where you are. If you're walking ten steps to the mailbox and back, that's your baseline. If you're already walking miles, that's your baseline too. The app adds a little to yesterday, whatever yesterday looked like. No judgment about where you start. Just dignity, patience, and forward motion.

Who WalkReady is for:

If you're rebuilding after a knee or hip replacement, this is for you.

If your doctor told you to walk every day after a cardiac event, this is for you.

If you're recovering from surgery and have been cleared to start walking again, this is for you.

If you started a GLP-1 medication and know you need to move but can't face another fitness app, this is for you.

If chronic pain, fatigue, or a long illness has made every step feel like a calculation, this is for you.

If you used to walk and somewhere along the way you stopped, this is for you.

Why we built it the way we built it:

No streaks. Bad days happen. They shouldn't punish you.

No leaderboards. You're not competing with anyone.

No public feeds. Your recovery is yours.

No notifications nagging you. You'll walk when you're ready.

No ads. Not now. Not ever.

WalkReady Plus:

The core walking app is free, forever. Everything you need to start, build stamina, and track your progress is included.

If you want more, WalkReady Plus adds:

Cloud sync across your devices

Apple Health integration so your walks count toward your health record

How long have you got?
Where should it end?
What would you like to pass?
Here's your walk.

Answer as little or as much as you like — skip straight to a plain loop, or spend a minute adding the stops you fancy. Either way you get turn-by-turn walking directions, personalized pace guidance, and a route that adapts to how you actually walk.

Whether you're exploring somewhere new, getting your daily steps in, or trying to build a regular walking habit, Orbit helps make every walk feel purposeful.

HOW LONG HAVE YOU GOT?

Set a time or step goal and choose your pace — Relaxed, Regular, Brisk or Fast. You're not an average walker, so Orbit doesn't treat you like one: it measures your natural pace and stride using Apple Health, then learns from every walk you complete to keep improving your routes.

WHERE SHOULD IT END?

Choose Route to loop back to where you started or walk on to a place you pick, or choose Open to set out with no fixed route at all. Turn on Smart Turnaround within Open and Orbit keeps checking the way back, so you always know when it's time to turn around.

WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO PASS?

Add stops along the way, and combine as many as you like — a nearby park, a café or pub, landmarks ranked by popularity with pictures to choose from, or search for anywhere you fancy. Orbit shows you the minimum time your stops will add, so you know before you commit whether they fit your goal.

HERE'S YOUR WALK

• Spoken directions so your phone can stay in your pocket

results.description:
WalkPad Hero is the ultimate companion app for anyone using a walking pad at home or at their desk. It helps you turn walking into a consistent daily habit with automatic Apple Health tracking, clear progress insights, and personalised plans that adapt to your activity.

Whether you work from a desk, want to move more at home, or are building a low-impact fitness routine, WalkPad Hero keeps you accountable and motivated without complexity.

KEY FEATURES

• Apple Health integration  
Connect Apple Health and let WalkPad Hero use your activity data to understand how much you’re moving. Your walking pad activity can be automatically surfaced and monitored alongside your wider daily activity, reducing the need for manual tracking.

• Automatic walking pad tracking  
WalkPad Hero can identify and track your walking pad activity through Apple Health, helping you monitor your consistency without having to log every session yourself.

• Manual session logging  
Prefer to log your walking pad sessions yourself? Quickly record your sessions and keep them alongside your automatically tracked activity.

• Personalised adaptive plans  
Get a walking plan built around you, your goals and your available time. With Apple Health connected, your plan can dynamically adapt based on your real activity and progress — helping your targets stay relevant as your routine changes.

• Progress & insights  
See how your walking habit develops over time with clear activity, consistency and progress insights. Understand what you’ve achieved and how you’re progressing towards your goals.

• Daily AI Coach  
Get personalised daily guidance based on your plan, progress and activity. Your coach helps you understand what to aim for next while adapting to how you’re actually doing.

• Built for walking pads  
Designed specifically for walking pad users — whether you’re walking at your desk, adding light cardio to your day or simply trying to spend less time sitting.

• Works with any walking pad  
No proprietary hardware or direct walking pad connection required.

• Simple, focused design  
No clutter and no social pressure. Just the tools you need to build and maintain your walking habit.

WHY WALKPAD HERO?

Building a walking habit isn’t just about completing individual workouts — it’s about staying consistent over time.

WalkPad Hero combines your walking pad activity with Apple Health data to give you a clearer picture of how much you’re actually moving. Instead of following fixed walking presets, your personalised plan can adapt as your activity, progress and routine change.

Whether your goal is more daily steps, better energy, weight management or simply moving more during the workday, WalkPad Hero helps you keep progressing.

FREE & HERO PLUS

Manual walkpad session logging, streaks and basic stats are free.

Hero Plus is an optional auto-renewing monthly subscription that unlocks Apple Health integration, automatic walking pad activity tracking, personalised adaptive walking plans, deeper progress insights and the daily AI Coach.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Start building a smarter, more consistent walking habit with WalkPad Hero.

results.description:
Walksport is for walkers. It has everything you need to plan your walks, track your progress and make walking a consistent part of your life. Whether you’re an urban walker, bushwalker, casual walker, city walker, charity walker or someone who just likes to track your progress, Walksport will keep you walking.

We make it easy for you to track your progress, challenge yourself, set goals and achieve them.

Main Features:
Set your goal
Track individual walks
Track your weekly, monthly, yearly progress with statistics easily viewed at a glance
Join Feats to challenge yourself and to earn physical medals or in-app badges and stamps
Simple and easy to use

Download Walksport, take that first step out the door and keep moving. Walksport is non-competitive, staying focused on the goals you set – it’s perfect if you’ve been walking for a long time or if you’re ready to get started.

Be Well is a challenge-led wellbeing platform built to change behavior and build habits that help employees thrive, even on the most demanding days.  
 
It connects people through movement, tracks what matters and delivers personalized content across four pillars of wellbeing: physical, mental, workplace and personal.  
 
With a focus on support, connection and sustained engagement, Be Well turns healthy actions into lasting routines.
